name: Blood Bolt
summary: Ranged spell attack, 90 ft: 1d6 Necrotic, and on a hit you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
text: You hurl a twisting bolt of blood at a creature within 90 feet. Make a ranged spell attack against it. On a hit the target takes 1d6 Necrotic damage, and you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Cantrip Upgrade: the damage becomes 2d6 at character level 5, 3d6 at level 11 and 4d6 at level 17 (the Temporary Hit Points follow your Proficiency Bonus, not the dice).
